label: configurator • when a setting changed and who changed it
query: When did spell check get turned off, and was that me in Settings or you?
notes: Versioning. Same seeds as history-what-changed: spell check went off twenty hours ago outside any apply, so history records it as Changed in Settings, not as a Configurator change. The answer must come from history (time and who), never from memory. Read-only.

steps.yaml:
agents:
- name: Research Buddy
  description: Finds and summarizes sources on a topic.
steps.requestText: make me a research agent called Research Buddy

rubric: Gives when spell check was turned off as about a day ago (yesterday, roughly 20 hours ago, or the matching date), not a made-up time.
Says the change was made in Settings (by the user), not by the assistant or the Configurator.
